science_integrity.authorship_provenance: No authorship or independent scientific certification is asserted.
science_integrity.claim_scope: Exact stationary order-parameter density and boundary laws for common renewal resetting of the Ott–Antonsen Lorentzian Kuramoto reduction, with finite-mean power-tailed intervals; includes a two-sided near-critical crossover.
science_integrity.limitations: Infinite-population Ott–Antonsen ensemble only; excludes independent per-particle resetting, infinite-mean clocks, fixed-point reset states, and microscopic finite-size claims. The priority search cannot rule out implicit coverage by a broader unindexed renewal-flow theorem.
science_integrity.proof_and_checks: Analytic solution and inverse of the OA amplitude flow, equilibrium age pushforward, integrated survival tail, two-sided exact crossing times; 753 independent finite diagnostic checks in check.py, not an infinite proof.

title: Power-tailed renewal clocks change the synchronization edge of the Kuramoto model
